blurb: Church Hill Theatre, located in the charming town of Church Hill, Maryland, is a cornerstone of the local arts community. This vibrant performing arts center is dedicated to producing and presenting high-quality theatrical performances and educational programs for people of all ages. The theatre is housed in a beautifully restored art deco building.
